ns2:course.label: Successful Change Management for HR Professionals
ns2:course.description: Introduces students to methodologies and practices for successful change management within any size organization. In addition, this course is intended to guide students through the role that HR professionals play in change management and to apply these concepts in practical ways to changes. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Restricted to students in the online MHRIR program (10KS0364MHRU).
